Assumptions

  • Iz = 20 A from the installer’s own table "Example — IEC 60364-5-52 Table B.52.2, method C (development seed)" (1.5 mm²); values entered by the user, not supplied by this app; source given: IEC 60364-5-52:2009 Table B.52.2, reference method C, copper, PVC 70 °C, 30 °C ambient, 2 loaded conductors — values as publicly restated (ecalpro.com); 1.5 mm² rounded from 19.5 A to 20 A for example E3. Development and test seed only, not shipped in the app.
  • Temperature factor computed from the heat balance; a factor printed in the installer’s table may differ by rounding and can be typed instead
  • Grouping factor 0.8 typed by you
  • Circuit-breaker I2 = 1.45 × In
  • The suggested rating covers overload protection (C1–C3) only: disconnection (Loop impedance), short circuit, selectivity and inrush current are not checked here

Working

  1. f_θ = √((θmax − θa) / (θmax − θref)) = √((70 °C − 35 °C) / (70 °C − 30 °C)) = 0.9354
  2. Iz = Iz_table × f_θ × f_group × f_other = 20 A × 0.9354 × 0.8 × 1 = 14.96 A
  3. I2 = 1.45 × In = 1.45 × 16 A = 23.2 A
  4. Suggestion B13: Ib 13 A ≤ In 13 A ≤ Iz 14.96 A; I2 18.85 A ≤ 21.7 A
